bullets.title: World Chase Tag
bullets.note: ([@worldchasetag](https://twitter.com/worldchasetag))**.** Who knew parkour could be combined with tag to make a professional sport? [This video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rgWBm5ud20Y) has nearly 40 million views and gives you a taste of the action. I chanced upon World Chase Tag on [NBCSN](https://www.nbcsports.com/) ([@nbcsports](https://twitter.com/nbcsports)). It makes you wonder what other disparate games and skills could be combined to make something amazing. Salsa curling competitions? Skeet falconry? Handstand hopscotch fingerpainting? So many options...
